recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not loosen these Observation bindings under FHIR-16186; a future binding-strength change would need a new work-group decision because this issue explicitly rejected that change in favor of clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-16186 asked to change Observation.interpretation and Observation.component.interpretation binding strength from extensible to preferred or example. OO resolved the Published issue as Not Persuasive with Modification, keeping the extensible binding and adding clarifying text about laboratory origin, broader use, and extensible binding behavior plus an updated Observation Interpretation value set definition.
initial_application: The issue was applied historically. Commit 4342534086917887bff030557d7bbf16feb849f2 updated Observation element definitions/comments and the Observation Interpretation value set description for GF#16186. Commit ea97d97c83950127fccab3ff270178e5c5d27e3c aligned the value set definition text with July 2018 Harmonization, matching the Jira comment that the remaining work was applied in SVN 14508.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition keeps both affected elements bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/observation-interpretation with strength extensible and includes lab-origin/broader-use comments. The current value set description says it is intended for any coded interpretation use and explains when codes outside the value set may be used. FHIR-17402 separately handled the generic extensible-binding example work removed from FHIR-16186's scope.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current build-scope source already matches the final Jira and meeting decision.
